normalization.overview: Claims about fast decoding and enormous context on inexpensive GPUs come from unlike configurations. Capacity, context cache and bandwidth must be evaluated together.
normalization.whyItMatters: A 12 GB card may run a 27B model, but the attractive speed and context figures cannot be combined into one purchasing claim without a matched run.
normalization.ghostMeshTakeaway: Choose exact artifact, populated context and representative workload; measure answer quality, prefill, decode, offload and GPU contention before deciding on hardware.
normalization.falsification: Independently reproduce a single-12GB configuration with simultaneously populated 262K context, sustained high decoding rate, and acceptable task-specific quality without hidden capacity.
normalization.freshness: Community reports and repository revisions require exact artifact and backend recheck before reproduction.

claims.proposition: GGUF weight file size is not runtime VRAM; two-bit 27B weights can fit where four-bit files may not.
claims.assessment: File inventory and capacity reasoning; exact artifact revision matters.
claims.limits: File inventory and capacity reasoning; exact artifact revision matters.

claims.proposition: KV cache growth and implementation overhead compete with weight residency at long populated context.
claims.assessment: Architecture-derived approximation, not measured runtime memory.
claims.limits: Architecture-derived approximation, not measured runtime memory.

claims.proposition: A single 3060 12GB community configuration reported 96K context at approximately 9.7 tok/s with offload and MTP.
claims.assessment: Self-reported; not a same-system 262K high-speed benchmark.
claims.limits: Self-reported; not a same-system 262K high-speed benchmark.

claims.proposition: A 3080 10GB short-context MTP setup reported 64.4 tok/s under a materially different configuration.
claims.assessment: Short-context and aggressive quantization; no full-context equivalence.
claims.limits: Short-context and aggressive quantization; no full-context equivalence.

claims.proposition: A reported 262K window involved pooled GPUs, not one 12GB card.
claims.assessment: Multi-GPU memory and layer placement differ.
claims.limits: Multi-GPU memory and layer placement differ.

claims.proposition: MTP can accelerate some configurations, but community counterevidence finds no improvement in other tested setups.
Capacity, context, and bandwidth results cannot be added across unmatched measurements to establish one operational capability.
claims.assessment: GhostMesh editorial inference, not independently replicated throughput.
claims.limits: GhostMesh editorial inference, not independently replicated throughput.
